name: ʻEua National Park
reason: Rule 1+2: Wikivoyage and Tonga Tourism name it; Tonga's only forest national park, hiking hub.
objection: Big Ovava Tree and walks may be separate spots; Wikipedia-thin.

name: Big Ovava Tree
reason: Rules 1-3: Wikivoyage calls it the park's main attraction and Tonga Pocket Guide has a 3-hour hike to Big Ovava Tree #1; a quirky natural landmark.
objection: Could be read as part of the national park spot; hard-to-reach trail.

name: ʻEua National Park Coastal Walk
reason: Rule 1 met by tourism board and Pocket Guide, but the route is vague and no coordinates.
objection: Likely the same ground as the Lakufaanga/Rock Gardens or Lokupo hikes, so a near-duplicate and unpinnable.

name: Matalanga ʻa Maui
reason: Rule 1: one counted source (tourism board highlight list) only.
objection: A pothole, short look, no coordinates, no second source; likely under 30 minutes.

name: Liʻangahuo ʻa Maui
reason: Rules 1-3: tourism board highlight and Pocket Guide: natural stone land-bridge with a viewing platform and short trail.
objection: Sits beside Rock Gardens on one hike, so may feel like part of it.

name: Rock Gardens
reason: Rules 1-2: tourism board and Pocket Guide; about 30 minutes among rock formations with wild horses and seabirds.
objection: Adjacent to Lakufaanga Cliffs and may be seen as one stop.

name: Lakufaʻanga Cliffs
reason: Rules 1-2: tourism board highlight and Pocket Guide name the cliff viewpoints with interpretation panel.
objection: Near-duplicate of Rock Gardens, 10 minutes away on the same walk.

name: Haʻaluma Beach
reason: Rules 1-2: tourism board and Pocket Guide beach list; swimming, tidal-pool snorkelling, sunsets.
objection: Steep sandy access; small beach.

name: ʻAna ʻAhu
reason: Rule 1: one counted source, which lists caves generally; guided only.
objection: Little visitor detail, access needs a guide.

name: Cathedral Cave
reason: Rules 1-2: tourism board calls it one of the Pacific's largest underwater caverns, plus Pocket Guide; a dive site visitors reach with operators.
objection: Dive-only; the draw is an operator experience rather than a place one walks to.

name: ʻOtumatafena Tidal Pools
reason: Rules 1-2: tourism board highlight and Pocket Guide 40-minute shore walk between Ohonua and Tufuvai.
objection: Single-source for the pools by name; shore walk is modest.

name: Tufuvai Beach
reason: Rule 1: Pocket Guide beach list names it (counted), tourism board only mentions the shore.
objection: Small beach mainly for nearby guesthouse guests; one source.

name: Ohonua
reason: Rule 2: island capital, a service town; no visitor source names a thing to see or do.
objection: The visitor information centre is there, but that is a service, not a draw.

name: Tufuvai
reason: Rule 2: village; its draw is the beach and tidal shore, listed separately.
objection: Wrapper for the beach.

name: Kalau
reason: Rule 1+2: islet, no visitor source, not a visitable stop.
objection: May be a snorkel or sail target, but nothing sources it.

name: Ha Unu Beach
reason: Rule 1: OSM only; searched Pocket Guide beach list and tourism page, not named.

name: Kapa Beach

name: Ufilae Beach

name: Fangatave Cliffs
